title: Fuchsian-type singularity for the Finsler $p$-Laplacian with potential
summary: Let $Ω\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{n}$ ($2\leq n\in\mathbb{N}$) be a domain and let $ζ\in\{0,\infty\}$ be an isolated point of the boundary of $Ω$ in the one-point compactification of $\mathbb{R}^{n}$ with the ideal point $\infty$. Under some further conditions, we study Fuchsian-type singularity at $ζ$ for the Finsler $p$-Laplace equation with a potential $$-\mathrm{div}\mathcal{A}(x,\nabla u)+V|u|^{p-2}u=0\quad (1<p<\infty)\qquad \mbox{in } Ω,$$ where $\mathcal{A}(x,ξ)\triangleq\nabla_ξ(H(x,ξ)^{p}/p)$ for almost all $x\inΩ$ and all $ξ\in\mathbb{R}^{n}$, $H$ is a family of norms on $\mathbb{R}^{n}$…
